editorial_thesis: Fresh platform signals are making agent leverage more practical at the edges: local inference, spec-driven delivery, machine-facing web contracts, and enforceable privacy boundaries.

topic_groups.title: Local AI Edge + Open Models
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary-source signal plus a coverage gap; deliberately avoids the immediately preceding observability, spend, connected-product, and open-source-security lanes.

sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for agentic tasks
sources.why_selected: A speed-oriented local model changes the economics of routine tool calls and private context.
sources.usefulness: Use it as a low-risk router target for artifact classification, metadata cleanup, or local coding assistance.

sources.title: Portable Computer: local-first personal agent
sources.why_selected: The hybrid boundary is the interesting part: sensitive routine work can stay local while difficult work escalates.
sources.usefulness: Prototype a Buildn private-context assistant with explicit per-tool residency labels.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B on RTX
sources.why_selected: A single-GPU coding companion can reduce cloud exposure for repository navigation and repetitive edits.
sources.usefulness: Run a bounded repo-triage eval with read-only tools and compare patch quality.

sources.title: NeMo Switchyard routing
sources.why_selected: Routing at step level is more actionable than selecting one “best” model for an entire agent.
sources.usefulness: Add route decisions to Buildn artifact jobs: extract locally, synthesize remotely only when needed.

topic_groups.title: Agentic Development: Price-Performance + Specs
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary-source signal plus a coverage gap; deliberately avoids the immediately preceding observability, spend, connected-product, and open-source-security lanes.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 family arrives in Kiro
sources.why_selected: The combination of requirements, design, codebase context, and checkpoints is a reusable operating pattern.
sources.usefulness: Turn client briefs into requirement/design/task artifacts before asking an agent to edit code.

sources.title: Kiro spec-driven workflow
sources.why_selected: Externalized intent gives agents a stable contract and gives humans reviewable checkpoints.
sources.usefulness: Use a lightweight version for Buildn reports, integrations, and client handoffs.

sources.title: Property-based testing in agent delivery
sources.why_selected: Properties catch broad classes of failures that example-only tests miss, especially in transformations and parsers.
sources.usefulness: Add invariants to artifact normalization, ledger updates, and URL handling.

sources.title: Model choice as a development-stage policy
sources.why_selected: This is a better portfolio rule than assigning one model to planning, coding, review, and repair.
sources.usefulness: Define default model tiers for plan, implement, test, and review, with escalation triggers.

topic_groups.title: The Agentic Web: Readable, Callable, Payable
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary-source signal plus a coverage gap; deliberately avoids the immediately preceding observability, spend, connected-product, and open-source-security lanes.

sources.title: Cloudflare’s four primitives
sources.why_selected: It is a useful product checklist for any service that will be reached through agents.
sources.usefulness: Audit Buildn surfaces for machine-readable status, stable actions, confirmation, and payment boundaries.

sources.title: Markdown for Agents
sources.why_selected: Cleaner content lowers retrieval noise and token cost while improving citation and extraction.
sources.usefulness: Offer a compact report/data representation alongside human-facing HTML.

sources.title: Web Bot Auth
sources.why_selected: A caller that can identify itself is easier to rate-limit, authorize, and audit than an anonymous browser imitation.
sources.usefulness: Require signed identity or scoped credentials for high-impact Buildn actions.

sources.title: x402 payment protocol
sources.why_selected: Agents that can pay need bounded spend, receipts, and user-visible confirmation—not just a card on file.
sources.usefulness: Model paid research/API calls as explicit, capped workflow steps in Buildn.

sources.title: PACT privacy and authorization
sources.why_selected: Agent access needs more than API keys: purpose, delegated authority, and revocation must travel with the call.
sources.usefulness: Add consent source, scope, expiry, and revocation fields to delegated work intake.

topic_groups.title: Platform Privacy + Extension Integrity
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary-source signal plus a coverage gap; deliberately avoids the immediately preceding observability, spend, connected-product, and open-source-security lanes.

sources.title: Chrome Web Store limited-use policy
sources.why_selected: Extensions that quietly become data brokers or context collectors face platform and trust risk.
sources.usefulness: Use the single-purpose test in client browser extensions, agent sidecars, and internal tooling.

sources.title: AI-safety circumvention prohibition
sources.why_selected: Browser automation and agent tooling can cross from enablement into circumvention quickly.
sources.usefulness: Add a policy check to client extension reviews and agent-browser capability requests.

sources.title: Disclosure changes after install
sources.why_selected: Agentic features often expand data access after launch; disclosure cannot remain a one-time checkbox.
sources.usefulness: Version privacy disclosures with feature flags and migration notes.

sources.title: TestFlight update
sources.why_selected: Distribution tooling is where product teams validate consent, beta access, feedback, and rollback—not an afterthought.
sources.usefulness: Use staged beta cohorts for client-facing agent features and record feedback with build metadata.

sources.title: Apple privacy and security lab guidance
sources.why_selected: Those primitives are a useful baseline for personal-context features on Apple platforms.
sources.usefulness: Keep secrets in platform stores and make data ownership explicit in client proposals.
